title: These Foreign Markets Are Crushing US Stocks | Jack & Max

excerpts.label: All Country World Index beat S&P 500
excerpts.insight: ACWI returned 22.4% in 2025, beating both S&P 500 and NASDAQ despite narrative of US dominance.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: ROTATE TO EX-US. ACWI beat S&P by 400bps. Add EM and developed ex-US to capture global breadth.

excerpts.label: South Korea up 95%, EM up 34%
excerpts.insight: South Korea led all markets at +95.3% (SK Hynix), EM returned +34%, most European countries outperformed US.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: BUY KOREA AND EM. Memory shortage (SK Hynix) driving Korea. EM crushed US—don't fight this momentum.

excerpts.label: China had 81 stocks double vs US 43
excerpts.insight: Of 297 global stocks >$5B up 100%+, China had 81 vs US 43. MSCI China index underweights many winners.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: USE ACTIVE CHINA. Passive indexes miss winners. Tilt to momentum names in China, not broad benchmarks.

excerpts.label: Memory semis destroying everything
excerpts.insight: SK Hynix, Western Digital, Lam Research up 300-400% on HBM shortage for AI training. Shortage persists in 2026.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: LONG MEMORY SEMIS. HBM shortage has legs. Buy SK Hynix, Western Digital, Lam—more levered than hyperscalers.

excerpts.label: OpenAI funding gates AI capex cycle
excerpts.insight: AI trade is procyclical. OpenAI raising $100B at $800B valuation signals capital still flowing. Fifth or sixth inning of boom.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: STAY LONG AI UNTIL FUNDING BREAKS. Monitor OpenAI/VC headlines. If they can't raise, exit AI complex immediately.

excerpts.label: Corporate profits up, labor market down
excerpts.insight: Unprecedented divergence: profits soaring while labor weakens. AI productivity allows margin expansion without hiring.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: NEW REGIME. Don't auto-sell on weak payrolls if earnings strong. AI enables profit growth without jobs.

excerpts.label: Recession risk severely underpriced
excerpts.insight: 57% fear AI bubble, only 9% rank recession in top 3 risks. Growth deceleration ongoing since 2021.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: HEDGE RECESSION. Consensus has this backwards. Hard landing is the real risk, not AI bubble pop.
